incident: Canonical transition functions accepted valid status names but did not prevent a terminal VERIFIED/FULFILLED state from being reopened by a later caller.
root_cause: State validation checked membership, not transition monotonicity.
prevention_rule: Terminal operation and obligation truth is monotonic. VERIFIED/COMPENSATED and FULFILLED/CANCELLED/BREACHED may only replay to the same terminal state for evidence refresh; reopening requires a new obligation/operation lineage.

related_incidents.observation: GitHub failed-job rerun retained the original pull_request event payload after Base-SHA metadata was corrected.
related_incidents.prevention: After machine-readable PR metadata changes, require a fresh synchronize/head event before treating Required preflight as authoritative; do not rely on rerunning the old event.
